pages.name: Northwind Labs
pages.tagline: Payments infrastructure for businesses that outgrew their bank.
pages.description: Northwind Labs builds the settlement layer under India's fastest-growing marketplaces. Our APIs move money between buyers, sellers and logistics partners in one call, with reconciliation that finance teams can actually read. Founded by two former payments engineers who spent a decade watching spreadsheets do the job of software.

pages.name: Medha Health
pages.tagline: Clinical records that follow the patient, not the hospital.
pages.description: Medha Health gives clinicians one view of a patient across every hospital they have visited. We handle consent, de-duplication and the messy business of matching records written by twelve different systems. Used in 140 hospitals across seven states, with the patient holding the key to every record we hold.

pages.name: Terra Freight
pages.tagline: Full-truckload movement, priced before the truck leaves.
pages.description: Terra Freight runs long-haul road freight across the western corridor with pricing that is quoted, fixed and honoured. Fifteen hundred trucks on the network, live tracking on every load, and settlement to the driver within 48 hours of delivery.

pages.name: Atlas Studio
pages.tagline: Brand and product design for companies with something to prove.
pages.description: A studio of eleven — designers, writers and one very patient producer. We take on four engagements a year and stay on each one long enough to see it ship. Identity, product design and the design systems that keep both alive after we leave.

pages.name: Kavach Legal
pages.tagline: Contract review for teams without a legal department.
pages.description: Kavach Legal reviews commercial contracts on a fixed fee and a two-day turnaround. Twenty-six lawyers, a standing playbook per contract type, and a redline you can send to the other side without rewriting it first. Regulated practice, ordinary language.

pages.name: Saanjh Learning
pages.tagline: Vocational training that ends in a job, or it is free.
pages.description: Saanjh Learning trains electricians, fitters and CNC operators in twelve-week cohorts, with the placement written into the enrolment. Eighty-one per cent of our 2025 cohorts were placed within sixty days. Employers pay on placement; students pay nothing until they are earning.
